standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 7855-7860: Hom_{O_X}(K, E) = Hom_{O_U}(La^*K, La^*E).

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing and the Hom exact sequence for cartesian modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 7862-7872: the first arrow is injective by the nullity lemma; its image is the kernel of the second by the Hom lemma for cartesian modules.

core_obligations: Setup (proof lines 7844-7853): K_n = La_n^*K and E_n = La_n^*E are the simplicial systems of the derived category of modules associated to La^*K and La^*E; the assumed vanishing Ext^i_{O_{U_n}}(K_n, E_n) = 0 for i < 0 and all n.

Part (2) (lines 7855-7874): by the unbounded cohomological-descent lemma Hom_{O_X}(K, E) = Hom_{O_U}(La^*K, La^*E); the resulting sequence 0 -> Hom_{O_U}(La^*K, La^*E) -> Hom_{O_{U_0}}(K_0, E_0) -> Hom_{O_{U_1}}(K_1, E_1) is exact - injectivity by the nullity lemma for cartesian modules, and the image equals the kernel by the Hom lemma for cartesian modules.
Part (1) (lines 7874-7876): applying part (2) with K[i] and E for i > 0 gives Ext^i_{O_X}(K, E) = 0 for i < 0.
proof_roadmap: Identify the component data as simplicial systems of the derived category.
Transfer the Hom computation to the total site by cohomological descent.
Read off exactness from the nullity and Hom lemmas for cartesian modules; shift for part (1).
difficulty_reason: Vanishing lemma (statement 7818-7842, proof 7844-7876): the negative-Ext vanishing on the components of an fppf hypercovering descends to X - part (2) is an exact Hom sequence assembled from cohomological descent (card L46153) and the cartesian-module nullity and Hom lemmas, part (1) follows by shifting; no verification is omitted. H2: derived descent bookkeeping.
